title: Theft Report
summary: The chauffeur found the roadster's bay empty at seven. Doors locked, alarm armed.
details: Reported by Thomas Reece at 07:05. The main garage doors were locked and the alarm armed when he arrived at 07:00 to start the Sunday polish.

title: Insurance Schedule
summary: Agreed value raised from £95,000 to £180,000 on Tuesday.
details: Sterling Mutual: 1961 Castellane Sprint, chassis 004. Agreed value revised to £180,000 on 5 June by P. Crowe.

title: Garage Alarm Printout
summary: Disarmed at 02:04 and re-armed at 02:30 with code 3: the chauffeur's code.
details:
Sat 23:00 ARMED (code 1)
Sun 02:04 DISARMED (code 3)
Sun 02:30 ARMED (code 3)
Sun 07:02 DISARMED (code 3)

Code 1 is the owner's. Code 3 is the chauffeur's.

title: Push Marks on the Drive
summary: The roadster was pushed down the drive, not driven. No exhaust soot.
details: No fresh exhaust deposit on the wall behind the bay. Scuff marks and a trail of oil spots down the gravel drive to the lane, consistent with the car rolling with its handbrake off.

title: Mrs Albury's Account
summary: A grey Bentley on the lane from 23:45 for ten minutes.
details: The neighbour across the lane: 'A big grey Bentley, engine running, from quarter to twelve for about ten minutes. Then it drove off towards town.' Desmond Pryce drives a grey Bentley.

title: Casino Demand to Oliver Hale
details: The Regency Club: 'outstanding balance of £22,000 ... must be settled within fourteen days of this letter.' Dated 1 June.

title: Workshop Key Board
summary: Oliver signed out the roadster's spare key at 17:00 Saturday, back at 19:30.
details: Ferri Coachworks key board, hook 12 (Castellane spare): 'Sat 17:00 O.H. — back 19:30.'

title: Photographer's Receipt
summary: Oliver had the roadster photographed on Saturday afternoon for a sale brochure.
details: Fenwick Studio: 'Location shoot, Castellane roadster, Hale House garage, 17:30–19:00. Client: O. Hale.' Contact sheets attached. The car went back in its bay at 19:10.

title: Motor Club Porter's Book
summary: Pryce back at the club at 00:20. He stayed the night.
details: Night porter, Royal Motor Club: 'Mr Pryce returned 00:20, retired to his room. Breakfast 08:00.' The porter's desk faces the only door.

title: Betting Slips and a Final Demand
summary: Reece owes a Mill Lane bookmaker £9,000.
details: Torn slips from Sully's on Mill Lane, and a demand: '£9,000 by the 15th, or we'll discuss it in person.'

title: Letter from a Rotterdam Dealer
summary: A Dutch dealer offering to take a 1961 Castellane Sprint 'no papers required'.
details: Van der Berg Classics, Rotterdam: 'We can take a 1961 Castellane Sprint, no papers required, on delivery to our agent. Payment in cash.' Addressed to T.R.

title: Kingsway Job Sheet 6612
summary: A night pickup at 02:20 on Ashgrove Lane, booked on Wednesday by T. Reece.
details: Kingsway Transport job 6612, booked by telephone Wednesday 6 June: 'Night pickup Sun 02:20, Ashgrove Lane. One classic roadster, drive-on. Deliver Harwich docks. Cash. Contact: T. Reece.'

title: The Night Driver's Account
summary: The Kingsway driver: the man who rolled the car onto the lorry was the chauffeur.
details: 'The bloke who rolled it on was the chauffeur from the big house. Uniform trousers, pullover over the top. He pushed it down the drive himself, with the handbrake off. Twenty past two.'

title: Crowe's Valuation Report
summary: Tuesday's report: only the owner and the chauffeur hold alarm codes.
details: Revaluation to £180,000. Security note: 'Alarm codes held by the owner (code 1) and the chauffeur (code 3) only. Recommend a second code holder and a lane camera.'
